basic_profile.bio: I'm a postal worker based in the Midwest, juggling between shifts and exploring historical events in my free time. I joined Reddit to connect with fellow USPS employees and history enthusiasts. I enjoy discussing historical events, particularly those related to postal services, and sharing tips about navigating the USPS systems. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late evenings after a long day of work. I'm single and currently focused on my career.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a hands-on understanding of postal operations, gained through my job at USPS. I also have a strong interest in history, which I nurture by reading books and online articles. My knowledge is largely self-taught, complemented by discussions with colleagues and online communities.
